FM Restoration sound effects, 2026-10-27

All 25 short sound effects are original offline synthesis authored for this
project by Tools/Audio/Restoration/render-sfx.py. They use mathematical oscillators,
seeded filtered noise, envelopes and short stereo reflections. They contain no
third-party audio recordings, samples, voice, watermark or cloned voice.

These effects are remaster additions, not recovered original Fantasy Masters
sound effects or original client source. Existing BGM recordings and their
separate provenance notices are unchanged.

The source recipe, cue names, exact output SHA-256 values and technical waveform
checks are recorded beside the generator in sfx-manifest.json. The generator
uses NumPy and SciPy only as signal-processing tools; their code is not embedded
in the game runtime.
